title: Trump FCC faces blowback in attempt to police speech on broadcast TV
summary: Similar to its previous filings , Disney said the Trump administration is retaliating against ABC for exercising its First Amendment rights. “For years, President Trump has expressly demanded that the Commission revoke ABC’s broadcast licenses for speech he dislikes.
